title: Keep merge_ready honest from close, gate uat, worktree merge/unregister, and surface it in status
action: Per D2 wire the helper from mrf-1 (workflow_store::merge_ready) into four verbs, each call fail-open and never altering the verb's own result or exit code. (1) drivers/close.rs: right after the full doors vector is assembled — both the dry-run vector (:1830-1841) and the real one (:1924-1930) — call `set_blocked_by(root, feature, &names)` where names = every door with blocking == true except "uat", in vector order ([] when none); this must run BEFORE any early-return refusal arm so a blocked close still records why; dry-run also writes (it is the same truth). (2) state_group/set_gate.rs run_gate_body: after the approved_gates write (:885-912) when name == "uat", call `set_uat(root, feature, approved)` for the target's feature. (3) worktree/phases.rs close_the_lane_on_merge (:495): call `clear(root, feature)` in the same mutation; ensure the lane-rewrite commit at :744-784 still fires when the only change was the clear (return a changed flag). (4) worktree/registry.rs run_unregister: resolve the feature (resolve_worktree_by_id + topology.rs read_worktree_feature) and call `clear` before teardown. (5) status_full/topology.rs build_lane_rows (:313): surface the record's merge_ready verbatim on each lane row (null when absent) per D3. Tests: drivers/tests.rs — a close with a blocking judge-debt door writes blocked_by ["judge-debt"], a green close writes []; state_group/tests.rs — gate uat true flips to approved, false back to pending; worktree/tests.rs — a merge removes merge_ready from a tracked lane and the lane rewrite commit fires; unregister removes it. Commit trailer `cell: mrf-2`.

truths: bee close records the names of blocking non-uat doors in merge_ready.blocked_by, [] when green
bee gate --name uat flips merge_ready.uat between pending and approved
bee worktree merge and bee worktree unregister remove merge_ready
bee status --json lane rows carry merge_ready verbatim

artifacts.substantive: blocked_by write before any refusal arm, both vectors

key_links: all four verbs write through the same merge_ready helper
prohibitions: no change to close door semantics, gate refusals, or merge preconditions
merge_ready never consulted by the uat gate or the merge door (D3)

trace.outcome: merge_ready is written by close, gate uat, worktree merge and unregister, and surfaced verbatim on status lane rows
deviations: close.rs has THREE full-doors vectors, not the two the cell named: the proof-debt refusal arm assembles its own complete vector and returns before the green path. Wired all three, because the rule the cell states (record before any early-return refusal arm, so a blocked close still records why) is what asks for it; a close stopped at the tests door would otherwise record nothing. Pinned by a_close_stopped_at_the_tests_door_still_records_that_door.

set_uat is called after run_gate_body drops its mutation locks, not immediately after the approved_gates write: the helper goes through the same ledger mutation seam and takes those very locks, so an earlier call would find them busy and fail-open into silence. Still strictly after the write.
merge_ready.rs was not in the cell files list but had to be edited to drop the two allow(dead_code) attributes the cell asked for; reserved under w-mrf-2 before writing.

worktree unregister takes the clear before the worktree-admin lock rather than inside it, so the record mutation locks are never nested under it. Still strictly before teardown. The test drives the extracted clear_merge_ready_for_worktree helper directly, since run_unregister itself needs a cwd-bound prelude fixture.

sync-ack: Additive projection only (D3): merge_ready is written and surfaced, never read by any gate, door, or workflow step, so no workflow-state skill guidance changes; the cell itself predicts affects_skills [] and the concept doc docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/merge-readiness.md already describes this exact wiring (landed by mrf-1).
